content: HEAD requests cannot return image dimensions (only Content-Type/Content-Length). To get width/height you must read the image header bytes. probe-image-size@7.3.0 does this via HTTP range requests but pulls needle@^2 (legacy HTTP client) plus lodash.merge and stream-parser. image-size@2.0.2 has ZERO dependencies, dual ESM/CJS exports, and parses dimensions from a Buffer (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF/SVG), so fetch with Range: bytes=0-65535 plus image-size gives the same result with no legacy dependency. Servers that ignore Range return the full body, so cap bytes read and abort.
